claims.text: The cleaning agent generally specified for grease or oil on metal parts is drycleaning solvent (SD), type II, or equivalent.
Drycleaning solvent (SD), type II, or equivalent must not be used to clean the CDR valve.
Cleaning the CDR valve with solvent will damage the diaphragm inside the CDR valve.
The authorized CDR valve cleaning method is to wipe the CDR valve and the CDR valve hoses with a rag only.
